friendly_name: Backup alerts name why the run failed
purpose_context: Since #1063 the canary pages within about 15 minutes of a failed 04:00 backup, but the alert names a pointer key such as restic_exit_code=127, not the cause. backup.sh will record a failure_reason code in its state pointer, declared diagnostic-only in the key_ledger, and the canary and health-check alerts will include it without it ever affecting health. Root never runs claude-writable code. Tracks kentonium3/kg-automation#1067.
purpose_tldr: When the nightly backup fails, the canary's alert should say why (for example, the backup drive is not mounted) instead of naming a pointer key.
